rule_metadata.author: Jennifer Batina
rule_metadata.title: Shell Spawned by Celery Worker Process

rules.rule_text:
title: Shell Spawned by Celery Worker Process
id: 904f6442-3b57-4b3f-987c-1559f58ce8d8
status: experimental
description: 'Detects a system shell interpreter being spawned directly by a Celery
  worker process.

  This behavior indicates a Python background task execution framework is evaluating
  raw string input through a shell execution context,

  which is highly indicative of successful command or prompt injection exploitation
  against an LLM agent task.

  '
references:
- https://docs.celeryq.dev/en/stable/userguide/tasks.html
- https://genai.owasp.org/llmrisk/llm01-prompt-injection/
- https://labs.cloudsecurityalliance.org/research/csa-research-note-promptware-c2-agent-exploitation-20260406/
- https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2021-23727
- https://owasp.org/www-project-top-10-for-large-language-model-applications/
- https://security.snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-PYTHON-CELERY-2314953
- https://snyk.io/blog/python-rce-vulnerability/
- https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-agent-prompt-injection/
- https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/05/07/prompts-become-shells-rce-vulnerabilities-ai-agent-frameworks
author: Jennifer Batina
date: 2026-10-17
tags:
- attack.execution
- attack.t1059.004
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
    - /ash
    - /bash
    - /busybox
    - /csh
    - /dash
    - /fish
    - /ksh
    - /sh
    - /tcsh
    - /zsh
    ParentCommandLine|contains: celery
  selection_parent:
  - ParentImage|endswith:
    - /python
    - /python3
  - ParentImage|contains: /python3.
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
- Legacy or custom administrative tasks deliberately hardcoded with shell=True or
  os.system execution inside Celery task functions.
- Media processing, deployment, or reporting pipelines that intentionally shell out
  to external tools (e.g. ffmpeg, git) from within a task.
level: medium
